# Beatmap browser and HTTPS

Metadata, covers and .osz downloads use https://mirror.hinamizawa.ai/.
API references: /docs/beatmap-search, /docs/beatmap-download, /docs/images.
Public search uses the CheeseGull v1 array contract, numeric status, amount=12
and sequential offsets. Empty pages end the feed; short pages do not.
Downloads use the same-origin streaming proxy /api/v1/hinai/d/{set_id}, with
an n suffix for no video. Requests identify OsuLegacy/0.118. No credentials,
API keys, tracking IDs or device identifiers are sent.

BearSSL 0.6 provides TLS 1.2 with SNI and normal X.509 hostname/time/chain
verification on iOS 4.2.1. Certificate checks are never disabled in the app.
Source: https://bearssl.org/bearssl-0.6.tar.gz
SHA-256: 6705bba1714961b41a728dfc5debbe348d2966c117649392f8c8139efc83ff14
MIT licence: BearSSL-LICENSE.txt. Source archive is in toolchain/vendor and
build-bearssl.py builds ARMv6 objects using the existing compiler/SDK shim.

BrowserTrust.h is generated by BearSSL brssl ta from browser-cacert.pem.
Mozilla CA extract: https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem (2026-10-20 certificate data).
PEM SHA-256: 796f1389bfea13c0ed78f663b765baaff54a508e5483786bd6ece73c5e3e3cbe
CA data is under MPL 2.0: https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
The source PEM is retained for updates; regeneration requires the host brssl
utility. The iPod's clock must be correct for normal certificate validation.

Network work runs off the UI thread, at importer priority, and checkpoints
pause socket reading during gameplay/editor work. JSON is bounded to 2 MiB,
artwork to 2 MiB and an archive to 256 MiB. Bodies are streamed to .part files;
only a finished ZIP is published to Documents/Imports. Import validation,
CRC/path/size checks remain in the existing importer. Same-origin proxy mode
avoids following arbitrary URLs supplied by metadata or redirects.

Search cache is keyed by the full query and expires after 30 seconds; cached
results can be shown if a connection fails. Empty results are not cached.
Only one search/artwork worker and one archive worker run at a time. A newer
query cancels the older one; completed stale results are not published.
The first browser version implements search, mode/status/sort/star/genre/
language filters, scrolling cards, covers, difficulty details and downloads.
It does not implement account features, comments/ratings or online audio preview.

Validation includes real TLS search and cover requests, a 6.4 MiB archive
checked by unzip -t, refusal with zero trusted CAs (TLS error 62), and host
controller/parser/UI tests with fixtures. Host tests alone do not prove
on-device network connectivity or scrolling performance.
